caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be a trivet or a similar item, rendered in shades of dark gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance. The trivet has a broad, leaf- or shield-like shape that tapers to a point at the top and widens at the bottom. The interior of the object features an openwork, ornate design composed of symmetrical swirling and curvilinear motifs, with several rounded and pointed sections interconnected throughout. The edges follow the contours of the decorative patterns inside, and at the bottom, the object has two short supporting legs and a rounded extension with additional scrollwork. The drawing is detailed, with attention to the texture and form of the metal object, and there are no other items or elements in the composition apart from some faint pencil marks and a small handwritten inscription on the bottom right corner.
title: Trivet
